verdict.rationale: Navan's developer docs list webhooks as part of the API surface, alongside OAuth client-credentials and the expense endpoints, so some event-subscription capability appears to exist. The evidence is a single passing mention with no detail on what can be subscribed to or how. Missing for 10: which event types are available, how subscriptions are created and managed, payload and signature verification docs, delivery and retry guarantees, and any independent or hands-on confirmation.
